interface.title: Hypnos — anesthetic PK/PD model divergence
interface.field: Pharmacometrics / clinical pharmacology of anesthesia (PK/PD modelling)
interface.stage_of_work: Simulating and comparing results: comparing published population models for one virtual patient before choosing or criticising a model (research and teaching, not clinical dosing)
interface.what_it_is_for: Overlay the predicted plasma and effect-site curves of every published PK/PD model for a chosen anesthetic drug, virtual patient and dosing schedule. It greys out models whose derivation envelope the patient falls outside, measures how far the models disagree, and offers side panels for synergy, local anesthetics, volatiles, reversal agents, pediatric extrapolation and pharmacogenomics.

data.note: All model parameters, envelopes, thresholds and pharmacogenomic rules come from a bundled dataset. Nothing was uploaded. On load the app shows propofol for a 72 y, 60 kg, 162 cm female with a 2 mg/kg bolus and a 6 mg/kg/h infusion. Switching to remifentanil automatically changed the doses to 1 mcg/kg and 0.25 mcg/kg/min. One PNG chart export was downloaded (2026-10-31T08-41_chart.png).

tree.general: Find out how much published models disagree for one subject, and whether that disagreement is real or within each model's own uncertainty
tree.specific: Compare published anesthetic PK/PD models for a virtual patient and see which are eligible, how far apart they are, and what the side panels say about related drugs
